images.prompt: Create a NEW original hand-drawn explanatory diptych for conduct-best-skills. Use the attached original illustration ONLY as a reference for the white circular compass assistant character and pen/pencil style, not its composition. Landscape 3:2. Two clearly separated side-by-side vignettes on a pure white background, simple generous whitespace, thin black imperfect ink, restrained teal and muted orange accents, intelligent playful academic editorial drawing. No text, letters, numbers, logos or titles. LEFT: the same little white compass researcher on a stool, thoughtfully consulting several separate small paper maps, each bearing a different simple pictogram: goal star, wrench, document with a magnifier. A human hand uses a pencil to draw the missing connections between the maps; a few loosely curled linking lines show the coordination is left to the user. Not disaster, no incompetence caricature, no stopwatch. RIGHT: the SAME compass researcher and a human hand together at a single large open planning map, with one goal-star, three relevant tool pictograms connected by a simple intentional branching teal route, ending at a magnifying glass over an unfinished checklist. The human hand points to the goal, compass arranges the route. Convey shared goal and explicit coordination, NOT automatic guaranteed success or speed improvement. Make each vignette occupy equal visual weight, compare organizational methods. No desktop plant, no coffee, avoid heavy peripheral decoration. Keep character proportions consistent with reference, expressive but not childish, outlined white body with teal needle and articulated thin arms. NO black blob creatures, conveyor belts, drawers, fish or borrowed cartoon compositions. The scenes should read at small README size, thick enough clear strokes, lots of blank breathing space.

Create a NEW original three-vignette hand-drawn science-communication illustration for conduct-best-skills. Reference attached original art ONLY for the white circular compass assistant's identity and pen/pencil drawing style. Landscape 3:2, white background, black imperfect ink, sparse teal and muted orange pencil accents, clean generous whitespace. Three distinct evenly sized vignettes arranged left to right, separated by wide blank gaps, NOT connected by arrows, NO text, letters, numbers, titles or logos. Left vignette: CLEAR AUTHORIZED TASK. A human hand offers a small card with a star and one clearly drawn path, the compass assistant confidently holds a wrench and follows that path toward a small document under a magnifying glass. Center vignette: MATERIAL AMBIGUITY. The compass assistant is stopped at a large forked paper map, gestures with an open hand toward a human hand pointing to one of the two branches; an orange question mark floats between them. Two equally plausible branch destinations (pencil and wrench) remain visible. Communicate asking about the goal, NOT taking over the user's choice. Right vignette: CONDITIONAL COLLABORATION. The original compass assistant is the central figure receiving two different evidence cards from two small OUTLINED white specialist helper instruments (one small magnifying-loupe character and one small pencil character). Each helper has its own little work mat; a human hand above gently offers an open permission key pictogram as an explicit cue that delegation is allowed. The compass carefully compares cards with a blank checklist, not an automatic approval stamp. Small separate work mats convey separate scopes. This is a metaphor for useful supported authorized collaboration, not a mandatory team or a recorded success. Draw objects and characters naturally with warmth and visual humor. Retain the compass assistant's teal needle, white outlined face, articulated arms, little shoes. Match line weight across all three scenes. Avoid plants, coffee, furniture clutter, gradients, glossy 3D, UI cards, black blob creatures, filing cabinets, conveyor belts and fish. Keep diagrams simple and concepts distinct at README scale.
